This matters this run: every proxied OKX request came back from a stale cache - the ticker body was 13 hours old, open-interest 5.7 hours, funding 21 hours and the long/short ratio 24 hours, and one candle URL returned a body from 1 June. priceSnapshot.note: THE RETEST HAPPENED AND IT HELD. Endday published at 69,573.7 with one condition attached to the 40.42 USDT it kept in cash: a retest of the level the daily had just reclaimed. The 03:00Z hourly bar delivered it - low 68,916.6, which is 66.5 points under endday's reduce line at 68,983.1 and 66.6 points above the resting stop it recommended at 68,850.0 - and then closed 69,197.1, back inside. Four consecutive higher hourly closes followed: 69,491.8, 69,421.8, 69,862.3 and the live 07:00Z bar which has printed 70,028.0. The overnight did exactly what a healthy reclaim does: it dipped under the line intrabar, refused to settle there, and made a new high. It has still not cleared the 20 August high of 70,064.2 - the session topped 36.2 points short of it. Price is above every EMA this report measures on the 15m, 1H and 4H, and above the daily 20, 50 and 100. The one average still overhead is the daily EMA200 at 71,684.3, computed this run from a 300-bar 1Dutc window, which is 1,901.7 points above spot and is the real ceiling of this leg.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $68,916.6 - the low of the 03:00Z hourly bar and the floor of the overnight retest. The distinction is the whole point: that low was already traded and rejected inside three minutes, so a wick through it means nothing, while a settled hourly close below it says the retest that held at 03:00Z is being re-run and failing. It sits 866.0 points under spot, above the 1H ATR of 532.6, so it takes more than one ordinary hourly bar to reach - which is what makes a close through it informative rather than noise. Below it the next real shelf is 68,385.6, the low of the 20:00Z bar that launched this leg.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above $70,064.2 - the high of the 21:00Z bar and the highest print of the whole move. The session just failed 36.2 points short of it, which makes it a tested ceiling rather than an arbitrary round number. Above it nothing this report measures stands between price and 70,688.0, the low of the 1 June daily bar and the first structural memory on the way back up. The qualifier: the 4H RSI is 85.5, the highest reading in this file, so a break taken here is a momentum trade with a fast stop, not a position entry.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD but the reason changes from 'the gate fired' to 'the retest held'. Endday deployed 20.00 USDT on a pre-committed daily-close signal and kept 40.42 back explicitly for a retest of the reclaimed level. The retest arrived at 03:00Z, printed 68,916.6, and closed 280.5 points back above it - so the condition the cash was being held for has been met and a second 15.00 USDT tranche goes to work, leaving 25.42 in reserve. The reduce line moves DOWN from 68,983.1 to 68,916.6 because the overnight low is now a tested floor rather than a projected one, and invalidation moves down from 67,828.2 to 68,385.6 for the same reason. The resting stop is switched OFF: endday recommended one because the gap to this report was eight hours across Asia; the gap to the morning report is four and a half hours across the Asia-Europe handover, and the 68,850.0 level it named survived the flush by 66.6 points, so a stop there now sits inside noise rather than under it.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is UP, and unlike last night the positioning agrees. The eleven-hour window splits 11,645,183 USD of short liquidations against 3,118,301 of long - 3.73 to 1 in favour of shorts, widening from endday's 1.39 to 1. In the last three hours alone it is 766,856 short against 3,753 long, a 204-to-1 skew: the tape is doing nothing but removing shorts. The confirming reading is the account ratio, which has FALLEN from 1.17 at endday to 1.05 now while open interest ROSE 4.42 percent from 2,143,443,965 to 2,238,221,065 USD. More contracts and proportionally fewer long accounts means the new money is arriving short into a market at its highs, and the perpetual is trading at a discount to spot - the premium reads -0.000467 and funding settles at the 0.0001 base rate, the neutral floor. There is no long crowding to flush. The honest caveat is the same one as always: this is REALIZED data, so it is a map of where the fuel was, not a forward heatmap of resting orders. The forward asymmetry is that the only untested air is above 70,064.2, while the downside pockets at 69,250 and 69,000 have already been filled once tonight.

The no marks remain 12 August midday and endday, 13 August midnight and midday, 14 August midnight, morning, midday and endday, 15 August midnight and midday, 16 August midday and endday, 17 August endday, 18 August midnight, and 19 August midday.
calibration.note: The prior report is 2026-08-19-endday, published at 19:50:00-05:00 with spot at 69,573.7. It graded YES and the margin is narrow but real. Its reduce line at 68,983.1 was breached intrabar - the 03:00Z hourly bar printed 68,916.6, 66.5 points through it - but no hourly close settled below, so priorReduceFired is false and the ADD stance was never invalidated. Its add gate at 70,064.2 as measured on the day's high was NOT cleared: the session topped at 70,028.0, 36.2 points short. So both gates held and the stance simply carried. Acting on it helped: it bought 20.00 USDT of spot at 69,573.7 and that BTC is worth 69,782.6 now, plus 0.30 percent, and the resting stop it recommended at 68,850.0 survived the flush by 66.6 points - a stop placed 147.7 points under the level it was protecting, which was exactly the right distance and not one point more. The sharper observation is about the 40.42 it did NOT deploy. Endday held that cash for a retest of the reclaimed level and wrote the condition down. The retest came four hours later at 68,916.6 and the cash was not there to take it, because a scheduled report is not a resting bid. That is the same structural lesson 19 August midnight learned in reverse when it held 24 USDT back for a 64,050 retest that never came: the reserve only works if something can act on it between sessions. Tonight's tranche is deployed 866.0 points above where the retest actually printed, and that gap is the cost of the schedule, not of the analysis.
